questions.q: Own exam question (portal response box): 'Discuss the environmental impact of a school giving every pupil a new laptop'.
questions.a: Balanced, developed points and a conclusion.
questions.model: The teacher writes the first point.

questions.q: suggest one policy the school could adopt.
questions.a: Repair scheme; recycling partner; energy settings.

questions.q: Explain one way data centres affect the environment.
questions.a: They use large amounts of electricity (1), which may come from fossil fuels, adding CO2 (1).
questions.model: Point: energy use. Development: cooling servers needs power; fossil fuels emit CO2.
